sections.title: Summary
sections.text: The model scores this case positive with probability 99.9% (logit 17.51).

sections.title: Evidence
sections.text: The strongest contributions come from patches 167, 132, 166. Patch 167 alone adds 0.29 to the logit.

sections.title: What-if
sections.text: Removing the top 5 patches changes the probability from 99.9% to 99.9%.

sections.title: Limits
sections.text: Decision-support demo, not a medical device. A specialist must review the highlighted regions.
